description: This file manages host environment security policies, including normalization, validation, and sanitization of environment variables, with a focus on security and compatibility.

methods.name: normalizeEnvVarKey
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable keys, optionally enforcing portability rules.

methods.name: normalizeHostOverrideEnvVarKey
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable keys specifically for host override purposes.

methods.name: isDangerousHostEnvVarName
methods.description: Checks if a given environment variable name is considered dangerous based on predefined lists and prefixes.

methods.name: isDangerousHostEnvOverrideVarName
methods.description: Checks if a given override environment variable name is considered dangerous.

methods.name: listNormalizedEnvEntries
methods.description: Lists environment entries with normalized keys, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: sanitizeHostEnvOverridesWithDiagnostics
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variable overrides, returning accepted and rejected keys with diagnostics.

methods.name: sanitizeHostExecEnvWithDiagnostics
methods.description: Sanitizes the host environment with overrides, returning the sanitized environment and diagnostics.

methods.name: inspectHostExecEnvOverrides
methods.description: Provides diagnostics on environment variable overrides without applying them.

methods.name: sanitizeHostExecEnv
methods.description: Sanitizes the host environment, returning only the environment variables that pass security checks.

methods.name: sanitizeSystemRunEnvOverrides
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variable overrides for system run contexts, optionally filtering for shell wrapper compatibility.
